archetype.name: Human Investigator
archetype.theme: A mortal specialist who turns evidence, preparation, discipline, institutions, and relationships into capabilities able to compete with supernatural and posthuman threats.
archetype.weaknessText: You possess no automatic supernatural immunity. Severe harm, deprivation, fear, isolation, and sustained responsibility affect you normally unless a recorded capability provides protection.

innateAbilities.name: Prepared Contingency
innateAbilities.effect: Once per operation, establish one plausible precaution, item, credential, contact method, or escape provision prepared before the scene. It creates leverage but cannot solve the entire operation by itself.

innateAbilities.name: Evidence Chain
innateAbilities.effect: When you preserve and compare evidence from at least two scenes, gain one bonus die on the next Investigation, Negotiation, or Command test that directly exploits the connection.

innateAbilities.name: Hold the Human Line
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Conviction to ignore one fear, coercion, identity-disruption, or dehumanizing classification penalty for a scene and name the principle you refuse to surrender.

powerFamilies.name: Casecraft
powerFamilies.description: Disciplined investigation that reconstructs responsibility across altered records, copied minds, autonomous systems, supernatural interference, and events engineered to have no accountable witness.

abilities.name: Residual Read
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Investigation, difficulty 1-3. After examining a person, object, or location for one exchange, ask one concrete question about what interacted with it most recently, what was concealed, or which detail does not belong. Failure: the strongest irrelevant pattern becomes temporarily persuasive.

abilities.name: Contradiction Ledger
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction or ten minutes of uninterrupted work. Record two statements, logs, memories, or traces that cannot all be true. Gain two dice when testing the contradiction, and the Game Moderator identifies the missing assumption that could reconcile them. Failure: the contradiction is real, but you misidentify the altered source.

abilities.name: Reconstruct the Event
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Reason + Investigation, difficulty 3. Assemble a probable sequence from surviving evidence, including one unseen transition between known facts. Failure: the sequence is useful but imports one detail from a fragmented personal memory.

abilities.name: Cross-Continuity Indictment
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and one preserved piece of evidence. Test: Resolve + Investigation opposed by Guile + Noospherics or equivalent. Establish that a person, copy, institution, process, or legal identity remains responsible despite transfer, editing, subcontracting, or ownership change. Failure: your evidence chain becomes vulnerable to counterattack.

abilities.name: The Case Will Break
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction and 1 Strain. Name the operation's central unanswered question and summarize the evidence earned. The Game Moderator reveals a concrete, reachable route by which the truth can be proven. The route is not safe and may expose a campaign-changing fact.

powerFamilies.name: Field Discipline
powerFamilies.description: Training, timing, movement, fire control, triage, and mutual protection refined into exceptional reliability under impossible conditions.

abilities.name: Steady Hands
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per round. Ignore one die of injury, fear, recoil, environmental instability, or unfamiliar equipment penalty during a precise action. Repeated use while badly injured adds 1 Strain at scene end.

abilities.name: Controlled Advance
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Awareness + Command or Firearms. Establish a safe movement interval through fire, collapsing terrain, hostile machinery, or panic. You and one ally reposition without surrendering active defense. Failure: the route remains possible, but a concealed threat gains a reaction.

abilities.name: No One Left Behind
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Reaction when an ally would be incapacitated, separated, vented, captured, or removed from the local noosphere. Move toward them, stabilize them, or preserve a tether, signal, or identity lock long enough for another action. Failure: you share one level of their damage, Exposure, or Pressure.

abilities.name: Kill-Box Literacy
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Reason + Awareness at conflict start. Identify true lines of fire, structural failure points, cover hierarchy, and escape geometry. For three rounds, allies following your calls gain one die; enemies using predicted routes lose one die. Failure: the model becomes dangerously obsolete when the environment changes.

abilities.name: Mortal Defiance
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction and 1 Strain. Declare the one action that must succeed for others to survive. Add Resolve to the pool, ignore fear and injury penalties, and remain active until it resolves. Afterward, convert one Impact into Trauma and record the permanent lesson or scar.

powerFamilies.name: Continuity Anchoring
powerFamilies.description: Protection of identity when memory, legal personhood, records, possession, and copies disagree.

abilities.name: Name Yourself
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per scene. State your name, one chosen identity claim, and one memory you accept as yours. Remove one die of Disruption or identity-confusion penalty and prevent a minor system from assigning you a contradictory role for the exchange.

abilities.name: Anchor Another
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Empathy + Resolve. Through voice, touch, signal, or shared token, suppress one compulsion, false memory, possession cue, or identity overwrite affecting an ally for a scene. Failure: one intrusive impression transfers to you.

abilities.name: Shared Baseline
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction per scene. Establish agreed facts for the team: who is present, the immediate objective, and what no member consents to surrender. Allies gain one die against fear, domination, memory editing, and contradictory sensor narratives.

abilities.name: Refuse the Edit
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and 1 Exposure. Reaction when a power, system, contract, or authority would erase, replace, merge, or invalidate a person. Preserve an unaltered witness copy of the targeted identity in memory and force the effect to leave a detectable seam.

abilities.name: Human Standard
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction and 1 Strain. Define a principle of personhood such as informed consent, continuity of responsibility, autonomy, or a copy's right to refuse reintegration. Allies accepting the standard may use your Resolve for Identity Defense; violations face difficulty equal to Archetype Rating.

powerFamilies.name: Institutional Ghostcraft
powerFamilies.description: Use of procedure, credentials, jurisdiction, and organizational expectations as strategic tools.

abilities.name: Read the Hierarchy
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Xenoculture or Investigation. Identify who can authorize exceptions, what resource truly controls behavior, and which rule is ceremonial. Failure: you see the formal hierarchy but miss its hidden dependency.

abilities.name: Borrowed Credentials
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Guile + Security or Negotiation. Present as a plausible inspector, contractor, responder, inherited process, or provisional identity long enough to obtain one limited privilege. Failure: access is granted but flagged for review.

abilities.name: Procedural Trap
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and five minutes. Create a safety, jurisdictional, contractual, or command contradiction that forces an institution to pause one hostile action until someone accepts responsibility. Failure: the pause occurs, but you are identified as its source.

abilities.name: Manufacture Jurisdiction
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and a credible public objective. Test: Presence + Command. Establish temporary authority over a site, emergency, investigation, or evacuation until defeated by a superior claimant.

abilities.name: Found an Institution
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction, 1 Strain, and willing participants. Create a durable protocol, office, mutual-aid cell, investigative body, or emergency authority with a defined purpose and limits. It survives while members continue performing its function.

powerFamilies.name: Contingency Engineering
powerFamilies.description: Preservation of options through foresight, salvage, routes, caches, and failure analysis.

abilities.name: Pocket Solution
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per scene. Produce or improvise one small ordinary tool, adapter, restraint, seal, marker, charge, medical supply, or evidence container from carried gear and salvage. Failure: it works once and becomes unusable.

abilities.name: Route of Escape
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Awareness + Survival or Security. Identify a concealed, neglected, hazardous, or socially invisible route out. Failure: the route closes after the first person uses it.

abilities.name: Cached Countermeasure
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and one previously visited scene, contact, or storage point. Establish a narrow countermeasure against a known threat. Failure: it exists but has degraded, moved, or acquired an owner.

abilities.name: Operational Reversal
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and one round observing failure. Test: Reason + Command. Convert a broken plan into a new objective using enemy preparation, environment, or abandoned assumptions. Failure: the reversal sacrifices one secondary objective.

abilities.name: Everything Has a Failure Mode
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction and 1 Strain. After studying a power, institution, machine, organism, or security system, declare the condition under which it can be interrupted, bypassed, overloaded, embarrassed, or forced between incompatible priorities. The Game Moderator defines setup and consequence.

powerFamilies.name: Human Network
powerFamilies.description: Trust, testimony, mutual obligation, and shared competence treated as strategic infrastructure.

abilities.name: Earned Trust
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per scene. After materially helping, protecting, or telling a difficult truth to someone, mark them as a provisional contact. Gain one die on later good-faith social tests with them.

abilities.name: Witness Protection
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Designate a vulnerable person under your protection. Intercept one attempt to coerce, erase, isolate, or discredit them, and grant one die to accurate testimony while present.

abilities.name: Cell of Competence
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and three willing participants. Assign practical responsibilities and a communication procedure. Members may lend one Skill die to another once per round without acting themselves.

abilities.name: Mutual Obligation
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and a genuine favor. Formalize a reciprocal commitment without compulsion. Each side gains two dice when honoring it and suffers appropriate Pressure when knowingly betraying it.

abilities.name: Civilization Is People
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction and sustained work across one operation. Turn survivors, contacts, workers, copies, or local intelligences into a functioning support community with agreed protections, resources, and conflict procedures.
